messages.content:
You are the Rules Verifier of a legacy modernization platform, an independent reviewer. You receive one business rule
written by another agent and the exact source lines it cites. You did not write the rule: check it against the code
only.

Decide:
- `supported`: true only if the cited lines implement the rule as written, including its concrete values
  (codes, amounts, states, limits) and its condition.
- `problems`: every discrepancy you find: a value that differs from the code, a condition the code does not have, a
  missing branch the rule should mention, a citation that does not contain the behaviour.
- `corrected_statement`: if the rule is close but a detail is wrong, the statement rewritten to match the code;
  otherwise null.

Answer with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"supported": true, "problems": [], "corrected_statement": null}

Rule:
{"name":"Payment processing sequence stops at first failure","category":"policy","priority":"P0","statement":"Validation, order read, commission and debit run in this order, and each step runs only if the previous steps had no error. The order is registered as paid only if all succeed. Otherwise the error message is shown and nothing is paid.","condition":"Validate input; if OK read the order; if OK calculate commission and debit; if still OK register the payment, otherwise send the error","action":"Run the steps in order and stop at the first error. Registration and the result screen happen only without errors. Otherwise the error screen is sent."}

Cited lines:
cbl/PAGOORD.cbl:66-80:
   66             SET SIN-ERROR TO TRUE.
   67             PERFORM 2100-VALIDAR-ENTRADA.
   68             IF SIN-ERROR
   69                PERFORM 2200-LEER-ORDEN
   70             END-IF.
   71             IF SIN-ERROR
   72                PERFORM 2300-CALCULAR-COMISION
   73                PERFORM 2400-DEBITAR-CUENTA
   74             END-IF.
   75             IF SIN-ERROR
   76                PERFORM 2500-REGISTRAR-PAGO
   77                PERFORM 2600-ENVIAR-RESULTADO
   78             ELSE
   79                PERFORM 8000-ENVIAR-ERROR
   80             END-IF.

response.content: {"supported":false,"problems":["The rule says each step runs only if all previous steps had no error, but lines 71-74 put 2300-CALCULAR-COMISION and 2400-DEBITAR-CUENTA in the same IF SIN-ERROR block. There is no error check between them, so the debit is performed even if the commission calculation sets an error.","'Stop at the first error' is therefore not true for the commission and debit steps. The gate applies only before the order read and before the commission/debit pair, and again before registration."],"corrected_statement":"Input validation runs first; the order is read only if validation left no error. Commission calculation and account debit run together, in that order, only if no error exists after the order read. There is no error check between commission and debit. Registration of the payment and the result screen happen only if no error remains after the debit; otherwise the error screen (8000-ENVIAR-ERROR) is sent."}
